1    
There are only red marbles and green marbles in a bag.
There are 6 red marbles and 4 green marbles.
Mason takes at random a marble from the bag.
He does not put the marble back in the bag.
Mason takes at random a second marble from the bag.
      
(a)  Draw a probability tree diagram to show this information. 
  
     
(b)  Work out the probability that Mason takes two marbles the same 
colour. 
(4 marks)

2    
Each day Paul wears either a black tie or a red tie to work.
On Monday the probability he wears a black tie is 0.6
If Paul wears a black tie on Monday, the probability that he will wear a 
black tie on Tuesday is 0.35 
If he does not wear a black tie on Monday, the probability that he will 
wear a black tie on Tuesday is 0.68
      
(a)  Draw a probability tree diagram to show this information. 
  
     
(b)  Work out the probability Paul wears different coloured ties on 
Monday and Tuesday . 
(5 marks)

3    
There are 8 counters in a bag. 
5 of the counters are red. 
3 of the counters are blue. 
Two counters are taken at random from the bag. 
Work out the probability that one counter of each colour are taken. 
You must show your working. 
(2)
(4 marks)
